answer.summary: Validates whether a given string represents a numeric value that may optionally include a leading sign (+ or -).
inputs: N#F: A character string representing the number to be validated.
outputs: BIT(1): Returns '1'B (true) if the string is a valid signed number, otherwise '0'B (false).

rules.text: The input string must have a length of at least 2 characters.
The first character of the string must be a valid sign found in the predefined sign set (P#VORZ).
All characters following the first character must consist only of digits found in the predefined digit set (P#ZIFF).
